verdict.rationale: Viam's own marketing claims "cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting" and remote monitoring for fleets, and its docs show threshold-triggered notifications from sensor readings, but only through user-written logic modules. Machine status and health are exposed via GetMachineStatus, but no documented built-in alert rules for faults, battery, or connectivity are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented built-in alert configuration, specific battery/fault/offline-connectivity alert types, notification channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
